items.title: TerraPulse: The Screenless Outdoor & Trail Agent
items.summary: TerraPulse introduces a screenless AI agent designed for outdoor and trail activities, offering a novel approach to wearable technology for nature enthusiasts.

items.title: Georgian Language Benchmark: Two Biggest AI Labs Clash in a Language That Doesn't Play by Anyone's Rules
items.summary: A new benchmark for the Georgian language highlights the challenges and competitive efforts of major AI labs in developing models for less common, complex languages.

items.title: ProgramGym: Scaling Training Environments for Long-Horizon Program Reproduction Agents
items.summary: Researchers introduce ProgramGym, a new framework designed to scale training environments for AI agents capable of reproducing complex, long-horizon programs.

items.title: VisionWeave: Weaving Elastic Visual Representations as a Native Capability of MLLMs
items.summary: VisionWeave proposes a method to integrate elastic visual representations directly into Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), enhancing their native visual understanding capabilities.

items.title: EmbodiedCLBench: Evaluating Continual Learning for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
items.summary: EmbodiedCLBench is introduced as a new benchmark for evaluating the continual learning abilities of self-evolving embodied AI agents in dynamic environments.

items.title: I Replaced My Entire Dev Workflow With AI Agents — Here's What Actually Worked
items.summary: A developer shares a practical account of successfully integrating AI agents into their entire development workflow, detailing the benefits and challenges encountered.

items.title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models
items.summary: RSI-Anything introduces a framework that leverages world models to enable recursive self-improvement in AI systems, pushing towards more autonomous and capable agents.

items.title: How 8-bit quantization shrinks an LLM to a quarter of its size — and why a single outlier weight can quietly ruin it
items.summary: An article explains the benefits of 8-bit quantization for reducing LLM size and highlights the critical issue of outlier weights that can severely degrade model performance.

items.title: Can AI Agents Make Open-Ended Scientific Discovery? Evidence from Station
items.summary: This paper investigates the potential of AI agents to perform open-ended scientific discovery, presenting evidence from a system named Station.

items.title: SoloQ: Calibration-Free Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
items.summary: SoloQ presents a novel calibration-free quantization technique specifically designed to optimize Diffusion Language Models, making them more efficient without sacrificing performance.

items.title: Pumpire: Unified Benchmark for Metric Distance Estimation
items.summary: Pumpire offers a unified benchmark for evaluating and comparing different methods of metric distance estimation, crucial for various machine learning applications.

items.title: Continually Post-training Small Models via Synthetic Self-distillation
items.summary: This research explores a method for continually post-training smaller AI models using synthetic self-distillation, enabling them to adapt and improve over time efficiently.

items.title: DiffusionART: Efficient, Stable and Scalable Reinforcement of Diffusion Models
items.summary: DiffusionART proposes a new technique for efficiently, stably, and scalably reinforcing diffusion models, enhancing their performance in generative tasks.

items.title: SepGen: Multi-Stem Audio-Video Separation and Generation in a Single Model
items.summary: SepGen presents a unified model capable of both separating and generating multi-stem audio and video content, streamlining complex multimedia tasks.

items.title: Reflex: Visually Grounded Reactive Humanoid Control
items.summary: Reflex introduces a system for visually grounded reactive control of humanoid robots, allowing them to respond dynamically to their environment based on visual input.
